name: 78063 · Pipe Creek, TX
findings: ZIP 78063 (Pipe Creek) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78063 (Pipe Creek) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78063 (Pipe Creek) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
